create_mistral_ocr_loader: create a MistralLoader instance to process a PDF file through the Mistral OCR API with sync or async support
run_sync_ocr_load: run the sync load method on a MistralLoader to upload, OCR, and return page-level Document objects from a PDF file
run_async_ocr_load: run the async load_async method on a MistralLoader to process a PDF file asynchronously via the Mistral OCR API
run_batch_ocr_load: run the static load_multiple_async method to concurrently process multiple PDF files with controlled concurrency
test_retry_logic: test the _is_retryable_error and _retry_request_sync methods to verify exponential backoff on transient API errors
